claim_scope: A context-local Ctrl-World response atlas from source-isolated reversible inference probes. It can establish measurement, uncertainty, and local support only. It cannot establish a repair effect, cross-backbone transfer, or self-evolution benefit until a held-out selector-gain evaluation is run.
formal_next_gate: Compare a fingerprint-guided repair candidate ranking with a no-fingerprint ranking on frozen held-out contexts using paired screen/confirm evidence, protected metrics, and equal candidate budgets.
